top_starred.name: affaan-m/ECC
top_starred.desc: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
top_starred.tagline: AI助手性能优化系统，让Claude等工具更聪明高效
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个帮助AI助手（比如Claude、Codex等）运行得更快、更聪明的工具包。它解决的是AI助手在复杂任务中容易‘犯迷糊’或效率低下的问题，通过给AI添加‘技能’‘直觉’‘记忆’等模块，让它更懂你的需求。普通人可以把它想象成给AI助手‘装插件’——比如你经常让它写代码，它可以记住你的编码风格；你经常让它查资料，它可以自动整理重点。创作者可以用它来定制自己的AI工作流，比如让AI自动处理邮件并回复。它适合有一定技术基础、想深度定制AI体验的人，上手需要一些命令行操作，但项目提供了详细文档，跟着做不难。

top_starred.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
top_starred.desc: The agent that grows with you
top_starred.tagline: 能随你成长的AI助手，越用越懂你
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个‘会成长’的AI助手框架。它解决的是传统AI‘一次性’的问题——普通AI每次对话都像失忆，而这个AI能记住你的偏好、习惯，甚至根据你的反馈不断调整自己的行为。比如，你用它管理日程，它会逐渐学会你的时间安排规律，主动提醒你；你用它写文章，它会模仿你的文风。它适合希望AI能长期陪伴、越来越懂自己的用户。上手难度中等，需要一些Python基础，但项目提供了友好的接口，可以快速搭建自己的‘成长型’AI。

top_starred.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
top_starred.desc: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
top_starred.tagline: 让每个人都能用AI自动完成复杂任务
top_starred.explanation: AutoGPT是一个‘自动AI’项目，它让AI能自己拆解任务、一步步完成，就像有个助理帮你搞定整个项目。比如，你告诉它‘帮我调研市场并写报告’，它会自动搜索资料、分析数据、生成报告，全程不用你操心。它解决的是AI只能‘一问一答’的局限，让AI能独立完成多步骤工作。普通人可以用它来自动化日常办公，比如整理数据、生成周报；创作者可以用它做内容研究。上手有一定门槛，需要安装Python环境，但网上教程很多，跟着做能学会。

top_starred.name: ollama/ollama
top_starred.desc: Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
top_starred.tagline: 一键运行各种大模型，本地AI工具箱
top_starred.explanation: Ollama是一个让你在电脑上轻松运行各种AI大模型的工具。它解决的是‘想用AI但不会配置’的痛点——以前要跑一个模型需要装一堆依赖，现在Ollama一条命令就能搞定。比如，你可以下载DeepSeek、Qwen等模型，然后像聊天一样使用它们，完全离线、隐私安全。普通人可以用它来体验最新的AI模型，或者搭建自己的AI助手；开发者可以用它做开发测试。上手非常简单，下载安装后输入命令即可，适合所有想玩AI的人。

top_starred.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
top_starred.desc: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. 🔥
top_starred.tagline: 让AI能搜索和抓取网页数据的工具
top_starred.explanation: Firecrawl是一个专门给AI用的‘网页浏览器’工具，它让AI能自动搜索、抓取网页内容，并整理成AI能理解的格式。比如，你可以让AI帮你监控某个网站的价格变化，或者收集竞品信息。它解决的是AI‘无法上网’的问题，让AI能获取实时数据。普通人可以用它来制作自动化的信息收集工具，比如每天自动汇总新闻；开发者可以用它来构建数据管道。上手需要一些编程知识，但API设计得很简洁，有文档指导。

trending.name: zouyuxuan122/Deepseek-Harness-EAC
trending.desc: DeepSeek Harness Desktop (dsh-desktop). EAC: Embracing All Creation (揽尽万象). Bundled Node.js runtime with full dsh-CLI kernel, one-click startup, 10 built-in UI themes.
trending.tagline: DeepSeek桌面版，一键启动带主题
trending.explanation: 这是一个把DeepSeek模型打包成桌面应用的项目，让你不用命令行就能使用。它内置了Node.js运行环境，双击就能启动，还有10种界面主题可选。它解决的是‘技术小白不会配置模型’的问题——以前要跑DeepSeek需要装一堆东西，现在像安装普通软件一样简单。普通人可以用它来聊天、写代码、查资料；创作者可以用它做本地AI工具。上手几乎零门槛，适合所有想用DeepSeek但怕麻烦的人。

trending.name: elie222/rakazo
trending.desc: Open-source Grok Bot alternative. Choose your own model and sandbox.
trending.tagline: 开源版Grok Bot，自由选模型和沙箱
trending.explanation: Rakazo是一个开源的AI聊天机器人，类似Grok，但你可以自由选择用哪个AI模型，还能在安全沙箱里运行代码。它解决的是‘商业AI不透明、受限’的问题——你可以完全掌控自己的AI助手。比如，你可以用开源模型搭建一个私人聊天机器人，或者让AI执行代码并查看结果。适合喜欢折腾的开发者，需要一些技术基础，但项目文档清晰，上手不难。

trending.name: Tiger3807861189/DeepSeek-V4-J-Space-Capability-Realization-Report
trending.desc: DeepSeek V4 × J-Space capability realization report — benchmark evidence that J-Space reduces capability-realization loss on DeepSeek V4.
trending.tagline: 证明J-Space能提升DeepSeek V4性能的报告
trending.explanation: 这个项目是一份技术报告，用基准测试数据证明‘J-Space’这个框架能减少DeepSeek V4模型在应用中的能力损失。简单说，就是让DeepSeek V4在真实任务中表现更好。它解决的是‘模型很强但用起来打折’的问题。普通人可能用不上，但开发者可以借鉴其中的优化方法。需要一定AI知识才能看懂，适合技术研究者。

trending.name: 0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness
trending.desc: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) ecosystem: curated plugins, tools, and infrastructure from dsh-external/hub and the public dsh-plugin topic.
trending.explanation: 这是一个收集DeepSeek Harness（DSH）生态的插件、工具和基础设施的列表。它解决的是‘想扩展DSH功能但不知道去哪找’的问题——这里汇总了各种资源，比如插件、脚本、教程。普通人可以浏览列表找到需要的工具；开发者可以贡献自己的插件。上手简单，就是看列表、按需安装，适合所有使用DSH的人。

trending.name: Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook
trending.desc: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 从 0 到 1 深度手册：安装/插件开发/性能调优/实测案例/同模型多 Agent 实测对比（中文 + 英文 PDF）
trending.tagline: DeepSeek Harness中文深度手册，从入门到精通
trending.explanation: 这是一本关于DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的中文手册，从安装、插件开发到性能调优都有详细讲解，还有实测案例和对比。它解决的是‘DSH资料少、英文难懂’的问题——这本手册用中文把DSH讲透了。普通人可以跟着手册一步步学会使用DSH；开发者可以学习插件开发。上手难度中等，但手册图文并茂，适合中文用户。

spaces.name: kulkas2pintu/wan555
spaces.desc: generate a video from an image with a text prompt
spaces.tagline: 用文字描述让一张图片动起来，生成短视频
spaces.explanation: 这个工具叫wan555，它能把一张静态图片变成一段小视频。你只需要写一句话描述你想让图片里发生什么，比如“一只猫在草地上打滚”，它就能生成对应的动态画面。对于普通人来说，可以用来做有趣的动态表情包、给老照片加上动作，或者帮你在社交媒体上创作吸引眼球的短视频。对于学英语的人，可以练习用英文描述场景，然后看AI生成的效果，直观理解词汇和句子的含义。上手非常简单，不需要任何编程知识，打开网页上传图片、输入文字，点一下就能生成，几分钟就能学会。

spaces.name: ReverseFaceSearch/Reverse-Face-Search
spaces.desc: Reverse face search to find someone online by photo and disc
spaces.tagline: 用照片反向搜索，找到网上的人或来源
spaces.explanation: 这个工具是反向人脸搜索，你上传一张人脸照片，它能在互联网上帮你找到这个人出现在哪些地方，比如社交账号、新闻图片等。它解决的问题是，当你只有一张照片但想知道这个人是谁，或者想找到照片的原始出处时，可以派上用场。普通人可以用来核实网友身份、寻找失联朋友，或者保护隐私，看看自己的照片是否被滥用。对于学生，可以用来做网络素养教育，了解个人信息安全。上手难度中等，需要上传清晰的照片，搜索可能需要一些时间，但操作界面直观，不需要技术背景。

spaces.name: agent-memory-leaderboard/leaderboard
spaces.desc: Unified memory evaluation · Results expected August 12.
spaces.tagline: AI智能体记忆能力排行榜，看看谁最会记事儿
spaces.explanation: 这是一个排行榜，用来评估不同AI智能体（也就是能自主完成任务的AI助手）的记忆能力。它解决的是AI在长时间对话或执行复杂任务时，能否记住之前的信息并正确使用的问题。对于普通人来说，这个排行榜可以帮助你选择更“靠谱”的AI助手，比如选一个记忆力强的来帮你管理日程或整理资料。对于学生，可以了解AI的发展水平，为学习AI方向提供参考。上手难度低，你只需要浏览网页查看排名，但理解其意义需要一些背景知识。

spaces.name: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Music3
spaces.tagline: 用AI创作音乐，MiniMax Music 3 音乐工作室
spaces.explanation: 这是一个AI音乐生成工具，你可以通过输入文字描述或选择风格，让它创作出完整的音乐作品。它解决了普通人不会作曲但想拥有原创音乐的问题。比如，你可以输入“轻快的钢琴曲，适合早晨”，它就能生成一段旋律。对于学英语的人，可以尝试用英文描述音乐风格，学习相关词汇。对于学生，可以用来为视频、演示文稿配乐，或者探索音乐创作。上手简单，界面友好，无需音乐知识，但生成效果可能需要多次调整才能满意。

spaces.name: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora
spaces.desc: Video generation with a synchronized soundtrack
spaces.tagline: 生成带同步音效的视频，画面和声音一起出现
spaces.explanation: 这个工具能根据视频内容自动生成匹配的音效或背景音乐，让视频更生动。它解决了视频制作中音画同步的难题，以前需要手动配音或找音乐，现在AI自动完成。普通人可以用来给家庭录像添加音效，或者制作有趣的短视频。对于学英语的人，可以观察AI如何根据画面生成声音，帮助理解英语中的拟声词和描述性词汇。上手简单，只需上传视频，选择风格，它就会自动生成音轨，但可能需要调整参数以达到最佳效果。

models.name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
models.tagline: 能看图说话的多模态AI模型，理解图像和文字
models.explanation: Qwen3.8-27B是一个大型AI模型，可以同时处理图像和文字，比如你给它一张图片，它能描述图片内容，或者回答关于图片的问题。它解决了AI理解视觉信息的需求，是构建智能助手、图像搜索等应用的基础。普通人可以通过使用基于它的应用来体验，比如上传照片让它帮你写文案。对于学生，可以学习多模态AI的原理，为AI方向打基础。上手难度较高，因为需要编程和API调用，但可以直接使用现成的接口，无需从零训练。

models.name: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF
models.tagline: 压缩版Qwen模型，普通电脑也能跑
models.explanation: 这是Qwen3.8-27B的GGUF格式版本，GGUF是一种压缩格式，让模型可以在普通电脑上运行，而不需要高端服务器。它解决了大型AI模型对硬件要求高的问题，让个人开发者和小型企业也能使用。普通人可以在自己的电脑上运行聊天机器人或图像理解应用，无需联网。对于学生，可以学习模型压缩技术，并动手实验。上手难度中等，需要一些命令行操作，但网上有教程，适合有一定技术基础的人。

models.name: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-MLX
models.tagline: 无审查版Qwen模型，回答更自由
models.explanation: 这是Qwen3.8-27B的“无审查”版本，意味着它不会过滤敏感内容，回答更直接。它解决了用户对AI回答限制的不满，但同时也带来风险。普通人可以用来探索AI的边界，但需谨慎使用。对于学生，可以对比审查和未审查版本，理解AI伦理。上手难度较高，需要技术背景来部署，且可能违反使用政策，不建议新手尝试。

models.name: OBLITERATUS/Qwen3.8-27B-OBLITERATED
models.tagline: 更彻底的无限制版Qwen，连系统提示都删了

models.name: HauhauCS/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive-MTP-GGUF
models.tagline: 带激进模式的无审查Qwen，速度更快
models.explanation: 这是又一个无审查版本，并加入了“激进模式”和MTP技术，可能生成更快速、更极端的回答。它针对追求极致性能的用户，但同样有风险。普通人应避免使用。对于学生，可以了解模型优化技术，但需注意伦理。上手难度高，需要技术能力，且可能违反规定，不推荐。

items.title_en: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
items.summary: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet these environments are hand-built and static: blind to an agent's weaknesses, and quickly left behind as it improves. While recent environment generation methods attempt to address this, they require domain-specific pipelines, rely on expensive or unreliable verifiers, and still produce static environments. To alleviate the engineering burden of rebuilding environments from scratch, we propose Environment Harness (EnvHarness), a programmable
items.title_cn: EnvHarness：唤醒静态世界以进行智能体学习
items.note: 提出环境生成框架，根据智能体弱点动态生成训练环境，提升学习效率。

items.title_en: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis
items.summary: Training terminal agents requires scalable executable supervision, yet synthesizing high-quality terminal tasks remains challenging. Each task couples an instruction, an initialized environment, a reference solution, and an executable verifier; if these artifacts are generated from inconsistent assumptions, the resulting task may be unsolvable or incorrectly evaluated. Meanwhile, multi-stage synthesis can discard the goals, dependencies, state transitions, and procedural constraints encoded in t
items.title_cn: FACET：在终端任务合成中保留源意图和可执行状态
items.note: 解决终端任务合成中指令、环境、解决方案不一致的问题，确保任务可解。

items.title_en: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
items.summary: We present 4DAnyone, a framework for reconstructing 4D humans from an uncalibrated monocular video by generating reconstruction-grade multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS). Existing camera-controlled video diffusion models synthesize plausible novel-view videos but fail to maintain consistency when scaled to the tens of target views required for 4DGS reconstruction. We identify this failure as a bounded-attention-context problem: when target views exceed
items.title_cn: 4DAnyone：从随意单目视频创建任意人的4D模型
items.note: 从单目视频重建4D人体，利用视频扩散模型生成多视角一致视频。

items.title_en: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
items.summary: Software increasingly functions as part of the scientific instrument itself, making failures in scientific code capable of compromising not only program behavior but also the evidence underlying scientific conclusions. Yet existing evaluations of coding agents largely emphasize aggregate task success, providing limited insight into why agents fail when repairing scientific software. We introduce SWE-bench Science, a repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering comprising 119 ta
items.title_cn: SWE-bench Science：编码智能体能解决科学工程任务吗？
items.note: 构建科学软件工程基准，评估编码智能体修复科学代码的能力。

items.title_en: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation
items.summary: Identity-preserving image generation becomes increasingly unreliable when a scene must contain many specified people. Beyond retaining each identity, the model must bind every reference to a distinct person and location, while training-time identity losses must establish correspondence among several noisy predicted faces. We introduce WithEveryone, a unified framework for generating group images up to ten reference identities. WithEveryone injects each selected identity as an addressed token, pr
items.title_cn: WithEveryone：统一规划和身份锚定用于群体图像生成
items.note: 生成包含多达十人的群体图像，确保身份一致和位置绑定。

items.title_en: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
items.summary: We introduce Semantic Task Completion Video Generation, an outcome-oriented video generation task. Under this formulation, success requires both achievement of the intended outcome and semantic grounding. Semantic grounding characterizes the correspondence between the reference image and the generated outcome in terms of high-level semantics relevant to the task. Evaluation focuses on the generated outcome and requires neither the presentation of a complete sequence of intermediate task steps no
items.title_cn: SemComp-Bench：视频生成中的语义任务完成基准
items.note: 引入面向结果的视频生成任务，评估语义完成度。

items.title_en: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
items.summary: Embodied agents are increasingly used to close the gap left by end-to-end policy models. Yet the agentic path has not realized closed-loop learning in physical execution: existing harnesses remain largely open-loop, following fixed skills during rollout and reflecting only after an episode completes. Such post-hoc reflection cannot govern execution as it unfolds, because physical interaction requires decisions to track rapidly changing robot-environment states at a frequency beyond today's large
items.title_cn: Zetta ζ：用于自进化物理智能的高效闭环具身框架
items.note: 实现物理执行中的闭环学习，通过实时决策改进机器人控制。

items.title_en: SemaPLC: A Project-Grounded, Verification-Gated Agent Harness for PLC Code Generation
items.summary: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) run industrial plants, and large language models can already generate independent program organization units (POUs) for them. Whether such logic integrates into an existing PLC project and then runs correctly has been checked only in limited tests. We present SemaPLC, a project-grounded and verification-gated agent harness assembled from conventional tools but governed by a strict completion rule. Rather than stopping when the model judges its own output ade
items.title_cn: SemaPLC：用于PLC代码生成的项目锚定、验证门控智能体框架
items.note: 生成PLC代码并验证其集成到现有项目中的正确性。

items.title_en: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach for improving reasoning in language and vision-language models, yet its strongest successes still depend heavily on ground-truth supervision (e.g., verifiable reward). Such annotations are costly to obtain and become increasingly scarce as reasoning capabilities advance beyond what humans can reliably evaluate. Self-rewarding RL reduces this dependence by enabling models to derive reward signals from their own completions. However, t
items.title_cn: Co-RL：多智能体强化学习中从多样群体涌现的无监督推理
items.note: 通过多智能体协作减少对人工奖励的依赖，提升推理能力。

items.title_en: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
items.summary: Recent advances in foundation models have enabled AI scientists to automate increasingly complete research workflows, from hypothesis generation and code execution to manuscript preparation. Yet workflow coverage alone does not provide access to the full evidence on which scientific discovery depends. Existing systems typically reason over text, code, labels, or precomputed summaries, leaving scientifically decisive spatial, temporal, cross-channel, and procedural relations unavailable to the ag
items.title_cn: OmniScientist：全模态全学科AI科学家
items.note: 自动化科学发现流程，处理多模态证据，支持长期任务。

items.title_en: Demystifying Agent Skills: Why They Work-Until They Don't
items.summary: Skills have emerged as a practical and effective approach for enhancing LLM agents at inference time through structured packages of knowledge. However, existing evaluations largely measure whether skills improve aggregated task success, leaving a more fundamental question underexplored: \textbf{When do skills help, why do they work, and where do they fail?} Through controlled experiments across various benchmarks, agent harnesses and LLMs, we isolate the effects of representation, outcome annota
items.title_cn: 揭秘智能体技能：为何有效，直至失效
items.note: 分析技能在何时帮助智能体，为何有效，以及失败原因。

items.title_en: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
items.summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been promising in single-turn LLM fine-tuning. However, long-horizon agentic reasoning introduces increasingly branching interactions and sparse rewards, exposing several limitations of RL: its heavyweight backpropagation-based training stack makes it impractical to fine-tune larger LLMs, and longer-horizon trajectories make credit assignment in RL substantially harder. This paper argues that evolution strategies (ES) can be a better choice for fine-tuning long-ho
items.title_cn: Agentic ESOpt：以最小GPU需求微调长程LLM智能体
items.note: 使用进化策略微调长程智能体，降低计算资源需求。

items.title_en: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution
items.summary: Frontier open-weight models are increasingly available, but serving them still largely assumes datacenter infrastructure. We present FreeToken, an edge-native MoE serving system that treats a personal machine not as a small GPU, but as a unified, elastic inference platform. FreeToken co-designs the full serving stack, including model layout and loading, expert residency, CPU--GPU execution, agentic state reuse, and runtime memory management, around two realities of local AI: agent workloads cont
items.title_cn: FreeToken：带宽自适应执行的边缘原生MoE服务
items.note: 在个人设备上高效服务MoE模型，适应边缘计算环境。

items.title_en: ASI-Bench: At the Dawn of Artificial Superintelligence
items.summary: Artificial superintelligence (ASI) requires AI to move beyond mastering existing knowledge toward exploring the unknown, creating new knowledge, and turning new ideas into verifiable results. However, the capabilities of today's AI systems are still largely built on learning, compressing, and applying existing human knowledge. Accordingly, existing benchmarks primarily test whether AI can produce correct answers based on learned knowledge, or whether it can complete tasks under extensive human g
items.title_cn: ASI-Bench：人工超级智能的黎明
items.note: 评估AI探索未知、创造新知识的能力，超越现有知识应用。

items.title_en: Embodied-Navigator: Point, Think, Memorize, and Align for Efficient Navigation
items.summary: Although Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced embodied navigation, their direct deployment remains challenging, as existing methods often force VLMs into unnatural action spaces that misalign with their 2D pre-training priors, compounded by rigid reasoning schedules and inefficient memory management. To overcome these limitations, we propose TAMP-Nav, a unified framework for efficient embodied navigation. First, we introduce a Pixel-to-3D Action Formulation (Point) tha
items.title_cn: Embodied-Navigator：指向、思考、记忆和对齐的高效导航
items.note: 结合视觉语言模型，通过像素到3D动作实现高效具身导航。

items.title_en: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
items.summary: Long-horizon agents can fail even when their underlying models can solve the constituent steps. They may lose track of mutable state, fail to reactivate lessons from earlier executions, skip known procedures, or stop prematurely. We bet on harness scaling to improve the execution system around an agent without changing its model weights. items.title_cn: StateM：通过框架扩展在Terminal-Bench 2.1上达到95.3%原始准确率
items.note: 通过改进执行框架而非模型权重，提升长程智能体性能。

items.title_en: Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) with group-relative advantages has become the de facto standard for post-training language model reasoners. However, when optimizing multiple reward objectives, existing methods typically scalarize the reward vector with a fixed weighted sum before group-wise standardization. We show that this design leads to two fundamental problems: rollouts with distinct reward profiles can receive identical advantages, and all objectives are optimized with fixed relative weights r
items.title_cn: 学习未掌握的：饱和感知优势重加权用于多奖励策略优化
items.note: 在多奖励强化学习中，根据奖励饱和情况动态调整权重。

items.title_en: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds
items.summary: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-
items.title_cn: HarnessEval-W：智能体化视觉世界评估
items.note: 自动化评估世界模型，提供可验证的推理链。

items.title_en: Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search
items.summary: Scientific discovery often involves optimising expensive-to-evaluate objectives over vast, structured, and open-ended hypothesis spaces, such as molecules, protein sequences, and computer programs. Generative models such as large language models (LLMs) provide expressive priors over such spaces, but their likelihoods and self-assessments are unreliable proxies for the objectives and calibrated epistemic uncertainty, especially for novel candidates outside the observed data distribution. We intro
items.title_cn: 大型发现模型：基于经验基础的模型驱动开放式搜索
items.note: 结合生成模型和贝叶斯优化，在科学发现中高效搜索。

items.title_en: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?
items.summary: Constructing an interactive 3D open world from a user query is important. However, existing methods are primarily evaluated on idealized, simple queries, making it difficult to systematically analyze and compare how multimodal agents understand user intent, use 3D tools, and reason over textual and visual 3D world information. To this end, we propose VibeWorlding, a unified framework for benchmarking and training vibe worlding agents: a multimodal agent that can autonomously infer user intent, p
items.title_cn: VibeWorlding：多模态智能体能端到端构建3D开放世界吗？
items.note: 评估多模态智能体从用户查询构建交互式3D世界的能力。

items.title_en: Can We Defend Against AI-Generated Video Attacks on Real-World Crisis Events? A Systematic Evaluation of Detectors, Generators and Social Dissemination
items.summary: Recent video generators can fabricate realistic depictions of wars, disasters, public emergencies, and other real-world crises, creating substantial risks of misinformation. Existing benchmarks, however, provide limited evidence on detector and generator behavior in such settings, including how detectability varies with generation conditions, how people perceive generated videos, and whether detectors remain reliable during social dissemination. To address this gap, we introduce RA-Bench, a benc
items.title_cn: 我们能防御AI生成的视频攻击吗？对检测器、生成器和社交传播的系统评估
items.note: 评估AI生成视频的检测器在真实危机事件中的可靠性。

items.title_en: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: Visual on-policy distillation relies heavily on an informative teacher-student asymmetry, through either a larger, stronger teacher or privileged supervision, such as reference answers or ground-truth regions of interest. This raises a fundamental question: where can informative asymmetry come from when nothing privileged is available? We answer this by inverting where the asymmetry comes from. Rather than adding privileged information to the teacher, we subtract information from the student. Th
items.title_cn: 自监督视觉在线蒸馏
items.note: 通过从学生中减去信息而非给教师添加信息，实现无特权蒸馏。

items.title_en: Beyond Final Scores: A Systematic Evaluation of Agents for Long-Horizon AI Research and Development
items.summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly capable of improving models, systems, and other technical artifacts through long-horizon experimentation. To understand the current state of this capability, however, evaluation must go beyond final scores, which neither reveal where progress is gained or lost nor indicate whether accumulated experience improves later decisions. We therefore present a systematic evaluation of seven frontier models on 36 long-horizon tasks based on a new framework that uses rule
items.title_cn: 超越最终分数：长程AI研发智能体的系统评估
items.note: 评估智能体在长期任务中的表现，关注过程而非仅结果。

items.title_en: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative Artificial Intelligence
items.summary:
Apollo did not reach the Moon merely because its engineers could solve difficult equations. It succeeded by turning a distant ambition into a mission architecture of explicit objectives, simulation, verification, and repeated correction. AI now faces a similar transition: frontier models can solve difficult tasks once the problem, tools, and success criteria are specified, yet consequential real-world challenges rarely arrive in an executable or verifiable form.

items.title_cn: Apodex Discovery：用于评估和构建发现型AI的现实基准和环境
items.note: 构建现实基准，评估AI将模糊目标转化为可执行任务的能力。

items.title_en: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a promising way to transfer reasoning capabilities from stronger teacher models, but applying it to long-context reasoning teachers and short-context students introduces practical challenges, including tokenizer mismatch, teacher-student distribution mismatch, response length explosion, and training instability. In this work, we study this setting by transferring proof-reasoning capabilities from the long-context reasoning model SU-01 to short-context student
items.title_cn: SimpleOPD：用于长上下文推理的简单分词器无关在线蒸馏
items.note: 将长上下文推理能力蒸馏到短上下文学生模型，解决分词器不匹配。

items.title_en: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
items.summary: Interactive world models must support persistent memory, responsive interaction, and long-horizon generation, yet these requirements place conflicting demands on the model. Maintaining history in the denoiser context or key-value cache incurs growing cost, forcing a trade-off between session length and retained memory, while low-latency interaction relies on few-step generation whose capabilities are bounded by its teacher. Evoke addresses both limitations by externalizing persistent world state
items.title_cn: Alaya-EVOKE：从线性扩展监督到无尽世界
items.note: 通过外部化持久世界状态，实现交互式世界模型的长期记忆。

items.title_en: DarwinX: Evolving Agent Harnesses Through Natural Selection
items.summary: An LLM agent's capability depends not only on model weights but on its harness: prompts, tools, skills, and control flow. Self-improvement loops already edit harnesses, yet single-lineage search is path-dependent and local wins often regress other tasks. We introduce DarwinX, which treats self-evolution as selection over a population of harnesses with the model frozen: a preserve-and-extend contract admits only variants that extend coverage without regressing, an archive keeps alternative lineag
items.title_cn: DarwinX：通过自然选择进化智能体框架
items.note: 将智能体框架视为种群，通过选择进化提升能力。

items.title_en: LLMRouter: Unified Infrastructure for Developing, Evaluating, and Deploying LLM Routers
items.summary: No single large language model (LLM) is optimal across all queries and budget constraints, making model routing essential for cost-effective deployment. Existing routers adopt diverse formulations and implementations, making fair comparison and extension difficult. We present a unified formulation of LLM routing as a sequential decision process characterized by five components: context encoders, model encoders, scoring functions, decision rules, and learning signals, covering single-turn, multi-
items.title_cn: LLMRouter：用于开发、评估和部署LLM路由器的统一基础设施
items.note: 统一LLM路由器的定义和实现，便于比较和部署。

items.title_en: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: We present DreamX-Phi 1.0, an action-conditioned video world model for robotic manipulation that, given an observed frame, a language instruction, and a prescribed action sequence comprising end-effector poses and gripper states, predicts the resulting future observations. Yet realism alone does not guarantee faithfulness: a convincing rollout can still move the wrong arm or lose the manipulated object. To ensure the prediction respects each arm's commanded path, we inject per-arm SE(3) transfor
items.title_cn: DreamX-Phi 1.0：用于机器人操作的动作条件视频世界模型
items.note: 根据动作序列预测未来观察，确保机器人操作符合指令。

items.title_en: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
items.summary: Scientific discovery increasingly requires AI systems that can reason over scientific evidence of heterogeneous modalities, interact with scientific tools and environments, and sustain progress across long task horizons. We present Intern-S2-Preview, a series of scientific agentic foundation models designed to support multimodal scientific understanding, reasoning, generation, and long-horizon tasks. The training pipeline begins with scientific multimodal pre-training over rendered scientific do
items.title_cn: Intern-S2-Preview：科学智能体基础模型
items.note: 支持多模态科学理解、推理和长期任务，自动化科学发现。

items.title_en: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
items.summary: Turning a research idea into a complete paper requires more than text generation: the system must retrieve literature, design and execute experiments, revise claims according to evidence, produce publication-ready figures, and maintain consistency across a long generation process. We present Spark-to-Paper, an end-to-end research paper generation system implemented as thirteen composable skills inside an existing coding assistant, without requiring a separate agent platform or orchestration serv
items.title_cn: Spark-to-Paper：端到端研究论文生成作为可组合技能
items.note: 将研究想法转化为完整论文，包括文献检索、实验和写作。

items.title_en: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
items.summary: AI agents operate in persistent environments where early state changes can influence decisions far into the future. Unlike conventional language-model interactions, agent behavior is mediated through a shared state that is repeatedly modified and reused across long-horizon workflows. Current safety benchmarks often fail to capture these cumulative risks because they focus on short, static tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce OpenART, an open-ended arena for scalable agent red teamin
items.title_cn: OpenART：通过开放式环境进化扩展智能体红队测试
items.note: 通过进化环境，评估智能体在长期任务中的安全风险。

items.title_en: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
items.summary: Recent work on distillation transfers the capabilities of large models to smaller ones often by updating the latter's parameters, through teacher forcing, on-policy distillation, and related training-time methods. In this paper, we ask whether such transfer can instead occur at test time. We study strong-to-weak scaffolding: whether a stronger builder model can construct inference-time harnesses that help a weaker target model solve tasks more reliably without any parameter updates. Using four r
items.title_cn: AI4AI在测试时：通过框架实现强到弱能力转移
items.note: 在推理时构建框架帮助弱模型，无需参数更新。

items.title_en: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
items.summary: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discover
items.title_cn: Mechanist：AI作为科学仪器发现智能机制
items.note: 自动化探索AI模型内部机制，理解其能力和风险。

items.title_en: SkillZip: Contract-Preserving Graph Compression for Scalable Agent Skill Libraries
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as agents whose procedural knowledge is stored in reusable skill packages and loaded at inference time. As skill libraries grow, a central challenge is to expose the smallest sufficient executable context under a limited context budget. Existing systems struggle to reuse routines below the whole-skill level, preserve procedural contracts during compression, keep compressed routines executable and expandable, and update the compressed library as skill
items.title_cn: SkillZip：用于可扩展智能体技能库的契约保留图压缩
items.note: 压缩技能库，保留程序契约，在有限上下文内高效执行。

huggingface.models_summary: 这些热门模型主要围绕Qwen3.8-27B，出现了多种变体：GGUF压缩版让普通电脑也能运行，无审查版则去除了内容限制。整体趋势是追求更高效、更自由的AI，但无审查版本带来伦理风险。对于想跟进AI圈的人，要注意模型压缩技术让AI更普及，同时要关注AI安全与伦理。备考AI方向的学生，应学习多模态处理、模型优化和伦理规范，这些是未来重点。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文主要围绕AI智能体（Agent）的框架设计、训练方法、评估基准和应用，强调在复杂环境中提升智能体的自主性、效率和安全性。热门方向包括：智能体框架（如EnvHarness、DarwinX）、强化学习优化（如Co-RL、Saturation Aware）、世界模型（如4DAnyone、DreamX-Phi）、科学发现自动化（如OmniScientist、Intern-S2）、以及安全评估（如OpenART、RA-Bench）。新手应记住关键词：智能体（Agent）、框架（Harness）、强化学习（RL）、世界模型（World Model）、科学发现（Scientific Discovery）、基准（Benchmark）。
